about: Zones a city sets for shared e-scooters, read from the layers of its public map: where to park, where not to, where to ride slowly and where not to ride. Neither city states a licence for them; since 28 October 2026 such public city layers are drawn, credited to the city. Each city's zones are in data/city-zones/<id>.json, written by scripts/update-city-zones.mjs from the layers below, with the bounds here: each zone is one ring of [lat, lng] points, simplified to within half a metre. Porto gives its parking places as points with their number of spots, so each is drawn as a disc of 5 m around its point. The map draws them from zoom 14, whether or not the operators' zones are on.

source.title: Bergen kommune, "Elsparkesykler i Bergen": in the inner city centre, park only on the marked places; in no-parking zones a ride cannot end

echoboomer, "Polícia Municipal do Porto começou a aplicar multas por trotinetes mal estacionadas" (6 December 2022): shared scooters are parked at the city's sharing points (pontos de partilha), and the operators are fined for those left elsewhere
